tasks.goal: a zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API for bookmarks: POST /bookmarks {url,title} -> 201 {id}, GET /bookmarks -> 200 array, DELETE /bookmarks/:id -> 204 or 404. In-memory store. Also write test-api.js, an executable probe harness that boots the server itself on PORT=0, exercises every route including the 404 and a missing-url case, and exits non-zero on any mismatch. Record verified probes in .atoma-probes.json (the harness as a shell entry). As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE: run the existing test script end-to-end via run_shell (node test-api.js) and confirm previously recorded probes still pass; the deliverable of that phase is the verified pass/fail outcome plus the probe-manifest update.
